title: Normal-incidence Fresnel reflectance
prompt: Implement `fresnel_R(n1, n2)` amplitude reflection |r|^2 for normal incidence: r=(n1-n2)/(n1+n2).
test_source:
import solution

def run():
    assert abs(solution.fresnel_R(1.5,1.5))<1e-12
    r=(1.0-1.5)/(1.0+1.5)
    assert abs(solution.fresnel_R(1.0,1.5)-r*r)<1e-12
